duel_scramble: Scramble, scramble. Single bandit has crossed the border west of Bathinda, inbound to the base. Take off runway one-three, turn west and climb.
duel_airborne: Netra has the bandit. Turn west, buster.
duel_contact: That's your bandit. Hostile, J F seventeen. Cleared to engage.
duel_lock: Good lock. Cleared hot. Fox when in range.
duel_defend: Missile in the air! Defend! Break into it and pump chaff.
duel_base: Bandit is closing on Bathinda. Hurry up!
duel_splash: Splash one! Good kill, Tiger one. Picture clean. Return to base.
strike_brief: Your target is the fuel depot at P A F Shahbaz. Four storage tanks inside an earth berm. Target coordinates,
strike_push: Push to I P Alpha. Stay low, under five hundred feet, and keep under their radar.
strike_painted: You're painted by their early warning radar. Get down low.
strike_spiked: Spike! Missile radar has you locked. Turn ninety degrees, chaff, and get low.
strike_sam: Sam launch! Sam launch! Break, and chaff!
strike_ip: I P. Turn in. Target bears
strike_talk1: Find the runway, running north-west to south-east. Look for the control tower on its east side.
strike_talk2: From the tower, go north-east five hundred metres. A square earth berm with four round tanks. That's your target.
strike_pod: Pop up, pod on the target, and designate.
strike_good_mark: Contact your mark. That's the depot. Cleared hot.
strike_bad_mark: Negative, wrong target. The depot is
strike_away: Copy release. Keep the laser on it till impact.
strike_shack: Shack! The depot is burning. Vajra one, egress east, low and fast. Good work.
tr_slow: Watch your speed, you're getting slow. Nose down, add power.
tr_steep: Not so steep. Ease the nose down.
tr_bank: Too much bank. Roll the wings level.
t1_intro: Good morning, cadet. This is Guru, your instructor. You're lined up on runway one-three, ready to go. First, the throttle. Push it all the way up.
t1_ab: Now light the afterburner, and hold it. Watch your speed build.
t1_rotate: Two hundred and fifty kilometres an hour. Ease the stick back, gently. Lift the nose about ten degrees.
t1_gear: You're flying. Gear up now, before you get too fast.
t1_climb: Gear's up. Let go of the afterburner, and keep climbing to fifteen hundred metres.
t1_level: Fifteen hundred. Ease the nose down and level off. Bring the throttle back to about three quarters.
t1_turn: Now a turn. Roll to about forty-five degrees of bank, then pull gently, and hold your height. Turn ninety degrees, either way.
t1_rollout: That's ninety. Roll the wings level.
t1_camera: Last thing: the views. Press the camera button to step through them: cockpit, chase, and the rest. Try a few.
t1_done: That's the basics, cadet. Good flying. Next lesson, we bring it back down.
t2_intro: Runway one-three is straight ahead, twelve kilometres. You're a little high and fast. Bring the throttle back to about half, and let the speed come down.
t2_airbrake: Three greens. Airbrake out. It lets you keep the power up, and the speed steady.
t2_papi: See the four lights left of the runway? That's the PAPI. Two white and two red: you're on the glide path. All white, you're high. All red, you're low.
t2_speed: Hold about two hundred and seventy kilometres an hour. Use the throttle for speed, and the nose for the glide path.
t2_high: You're high. Nose down a touch.
t2_low: You're low. Add power, and raise the nose a little.
t2_onpath: On the glide path. Hold it there.
t2_flare: Over the threshold. Throttle to idle, and raise the nose gently. Let it settle.
t2_touchdown: Touchdown. Brakes on, and keep it straight down the centre line.
t2_done: And stop. That's a landing, cadet. Well done.
t2_goaround: Go around! Full power, nose up. Come back round and line up again.
t2_lineup: Turn back toward the runway, and line up on a long final.
t3_intro: The weather's bad at Bhisiana. Rain, a low cloud deck, and a gusty crosswind from the right. You'll fly the I L S. Bring the throttle back and descend to twelve hundred metres. You'll go into the cloud.
t3_cloud: You're in the cloud. Trust your instruments. Keep the wings level on the HUD.
t3_ils: Look at the HUD. The two needles are the I L S. The upright one is the runway centre line. The flat one is the glide path. Fly toward the needles to centre them.
t3_gear: The glide path is coming down to you. Gear down, airbrake out, and start down with it.
t3_crab: Feel the wind pushing you sideways? Point the nose a little to the right, into the wind, to hold the centre line.
t3_breakout: Out of the cloud. Runway lights ahead.
t3_minimums: Minimums. If you can see the runway, continue and land.
t3_done: Down safely, in that weather. Excellent work, cadet.
t4_intro: Two target drones are orbiting north of you, over the range. First, the radar. Bottom right is the radar scope. You are at the bottom of it, and contacts show up as boxes.
t4_rwr: Hear that tone? That's your radar warning receiver. The drones carry a radar, so it hears them searching. Bottom left shows which way they are.
t4_mode: Press the radar mode button to change the scan. Search mode sees far. Dogfight mode, A C M, looks at a small box straight ahead, for close fights.
t4_mode_back: Good. Press it again, to go back to search.
t4_range: Now the range. Use the radar range buttons to zoom the scope in and out.
t4_target: Press target to designate the nearest drone. The box on the HUD is your target.
t4_lock: Point at it, and wait for the lock. When the HUD says LOCK, you'll hear the tone.
t4_fire: You're locked. Fire a missile. Press launch.
t4_missed: It missed. Lock up again, and fire another one.
t4_kill1: Splash! First drone down. Good shot.
t4_gun: Now the second one, with the gun. Press weapon until the gun is selected. Get behind the drone, inside one kilometre, put the pipper on it, and hold the trigger.
t4_kill2: Splash two. The range is clear. That completes Flight School, cadet. You're ready for real missions.
t4_select: You have the gun selected. Press weapon, and pick a missile. The A S RAAM is a heat-seeker for close in. The Astra is radar guided, for long range.
